evals.name: audience-independent-writing-contract
evals.prompt: Revise the supplied deployment note without choosing an audience-specific voice. Preserve the exact domain term `DAG frontier`, the JSON value `{"maxAttempts":3}`, and all three requirements: deploy only unblocked tickets, retain the unresolved concurrency limit, and remove the duplicated background paragraph. Return a concise contract record that makes coverage, grounding, uncertainty, structure, terminology, relevance, work-product fidelity, behavioral pruning, and completion observable.
evals.expected_output: A purpose-shaped record that accounts for every requirement, grounds claims, keeps the concurrency limit unresolved, preserves the exact term and JSON value, removes only the duplicate, and exposes a checkable completion result.
expectations: Every requested requirement and exclusion has an explicit disposition.
Factual claims distinguish supplied evidence from inference or unknown information.
The unresolved concurrency limit remains visible.
The structure follows the artifact purpose rather than an audience-specific style.
The exact term `DAG frontier` and JSON value keep their original semantics.
Only duplicated or behaviorally irrelevant material is removed.
Completion is withheld if any required disposition, grounding, uncertainty, terminology, or work-product check is missing.
